title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Revelation 4: the open door in heaven, the throne and the rainbow, the twenty-four elders, and the four living creatures.

questions.text: What did John see after these things?
questions.explanation: Revelation 4:1 says he looked and saw a door opened in heaven.

answers.text: A book sealed with seven seals
A Lamb standing as though slain

questions.text: What did the voice like a trumpet promise to show John?
questions.explanation: Revelation 4:1 says the voice said, "Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this."

answers.text: The things which are written in the book
The things which must happen after this
The seven assemblies that are in Asia
The works of the angels in heaven

questions.text: What was around the throne, like an emerald to look at?
questions.explanation: Revelation 4:3 says there was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.

questions.text: Who sat on the twenty-four thrones around the throne?
questions.explanation: Revelation 4:4 says twenty-four elders were sitting on them, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.

answers.text: The four living creatures full of eyes
The seven Spirits of God before him
Twenty-four elders in white garments with crowns of gold

questions.text: What are the seven lamps of fire burning before the throne?
questions.explanation: Revelation 4:5 says there were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

answers.text: The seven seals of the book

questions.text: What was before the throne, similar to crystal?
questions.explanation: Revelation 4:6 says that before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal.

answers.text: Something like a sea of glass

questions.text: What was the second living creature like?
questions.explanation: Revelation 4:7 says the first creature was like a lion, and the second creature like a calf.

questions.text: How many wings did each of the four living creatures have?
questions.explanation: Revelation 4:8 says the four living creatures each had six wings and were full of eyes around and within.

questions.text: What do the four living creatures say, having no rest day and night?
questions.explanation: Revelation 4:8 says they say, "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!"

answers.text: "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty"
"Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed"
"Come up here and see what will be"

questions.text: What do the twenty-four elders throw before the throne?
questions.explanation: Revelation 4:10 says they fall down before him who sits on the throne and throw their crowns before the throne.
